title: Circular with entry: ramp descends at 76-90 deg, not its 3 deg ramp angle: a steep chord to ring 1 and straight feeds down at every level

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
What happens: a Circular with `entry: ramp` (no zig-zag approach) never ramps at its ramp angle (3 deg, `Links::PLANAR`). On the #1558 repro (centre (-35, 2.9), R3 hole, Ø4 cutter, stepover 0.5, stepdown 1, top -0.508, bottom -11.524, climb, `helix_radius` 1), every descent that is not a rapid:

| Ring | Move | XY | dZ | Angle |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1.0 (ring 0) | first entry: Plunge, axial dive at (-34.392, 3.236) - noted ("the ramp's chord is blocked - axial dive on the floor instead") | 0 | 2.000 | 90 deg |
| R1.0 | every level change: a Feed straight down at pass[0] (-34.0, 2.9) | 0 | 1.000 (x11), 0.016 | 90 deg |
| R0.5 (ring 1) | first entry: a single Feed chord (-34.0, 2.9, 1.492) -> (-34.5, 2.9, -0.508), not noted | 0.500 | 2.000 | 75.96 deg |
| R0.5 | every level change: a Feed straight down at pass[0] | 0 | 1.000 (x11), 0.016 | 90 deg |

The straight-down level changes post at the cutting feed (500), not the plunge feed (250), and carry no note; the 76 deg chord is called a ramp. (`Descent::Ramp` with leg == e, as the #1558 review noted.)

Pre-existing: upstream main (d5a8c51 era, before PR #1601) gives identical numbers (same 1 + 2 + 22 + 1 moves at the same angles); PR #1601 does not touch the `Descent::Ramp` path. With `entry: helix` the ladder stands down to the zig-zag ramp, which holds 3.000 deg.

Expected: a ramp entry or ramp level change either descends at no more than the ramp angle (e.g. the zig-zag along the ring, as the helix's stand-down does), or substitutes by name (a plunge at the plunge feed, with a note), never an unnamed steep "ramp" or a cutting-feed axial feed.

Found while fixing the #1558 review on PR #1601 (probe: `circular()` with `Entry3D::Ramp` on the repro, every non-rapid move with dZ > 0 and atan(dZ/XY) > 3.01 deg).

Done means: a pin on the repro with `entry: ramp` that every descending feed move is at most the ramp angle or is a named substitution at the plunge feed; red on today's code.
